chapterInfo.content:
33
Mose hyira Israel
1 # Gye 49 Na yei ne nhyira a Nyankopɔn nipa Mose de hyiraa Israelfoɔ ansa na ɔrewuo. Na ɔkaa sɛ: 2#Yuda 14 AWURADE firi Sinai bae,
na ɔpue firii Seir maa wɔn,
ɔharan firii Paran bepɔ so;
ɔfiri akronkronfoɔ ɔpedu no mu na ɛbaeɛ,
ogya a ɛyɛ mmara#33.2 OGYA A ƐYƐ MMARA: Nkyerɛaseɛ wɔ Hebri kasa mu no nna hɔ papa. ma wɔn wɔ ne nifa mu.
3Aane, ɔdɔ ne man,
n’akronkronfoɔ nyinaa wɔ ne nsam.
Na wɔn deɛ, wɔtete wo nan ase
na wɔtie w’asɛm.
4Mmara na Mose hyɛɛ yɛn,
Yakob badwa agyapadeɛ;
5 # Eks 15.18; Yes 44.2; Eks 19.7-8 na ɔyɛɛ Yesurun mu hene,
ɛda a ɔman no atitire hyiaeɛ
na Israel mmusuakuo nyinaa hyiaa faako no.
6Ruben nnya nkwa na ɔnnwu,
na ne mmarima nso mma wɔn ase nhye.
7Na Yuda nso deɛ nie, ɔse:
O AWURADE, tie Yuda nne,
na fa no kɔ ne man nkyɛn;
ma wo nsa nko mma no,
na yɛ no ɔboafoɔ firi n’ahohiahiafoɔ nsam.
8 # Eks 28.30; Eks 17; Num 20 Na Lewi ho deɛ, ɔkaa sɛ:
Wo nokorɛ ne wo hann wɔ wo hotefoɔ no,
deɛ wosɔɔ no hwɛɛ Masa hɔ
na wo ne no ham Meriba asuo ho no.
9 # Mat 10.37; Eks 32.26-29 Ɔno a ɔkaa wɔ n’agya ne ne na ho sɛ:
Menni wɔn!
Na wammu ne nuanom,
na ɔpoo ne mma.
Na wɔdi wo nsɛm so,
na wɔkora w’apam;
10wɔde w’atemmudeɛ bɛkyerɛ Yakob,
na wɔde wo mmara akyerɛ Israel;
wɔde aduhwam bɛtua wo hwene ano,
na wɔde afɔdeɛ amuamu abɛgu w’afɔrebukyia so.
11AWURADE, hyira n’ahonyadeɛ so,
ma ne nsa ano adwuma nsɔ w’ani;
bobɔ wɔn a wɔsɔre tia no no dwonku,
ne wɔn a wɔtane no, na wɔansɔre bio.
12Benyamin ho nso, ɔkaa sɛ:
AWURADE dɔfo bɛtena ne nkyɛn dwoodwoo;
ɔkata ne so daa nyinaa,
na ɔbɛtena ne mmatiri so.
13Na Yosef ho nso, ɔkaa sɛ:
AWURADE nhyira n’asase;
ɔmma no ɔsoro nnepa,
obosuo ne ebunu a ɛtrɛtrɛ aseɛ no deɛ,
14ne owia mu nnɔbaeɛ nnepa,
ne deɛ asrane ma no fifire mu nnepa,
15ne tete mmepɔ atifi
ne daapem nkokoɔ nnepa,
16 # Eks 3.2; Gye 49.26 ne asase ne ne mayɛ mu nnepa,
na deɛ ɔte nkyɛkyerɛ no mu no anisɔ;
ɔmma no mmra Yosef atifi,
ne ne nuanom mu hotuafoɔ no mpampam.
17Ne nantwinini abakan, animuonyam wɔ no,
na n’abɛn yɛ ɛkoɔ abɛn;
ɛno na ɔde bɛsunsum aman nyinaa
aguo akɔduru asase ano.
Na wɔn ne Efraim apedu no,
Manase mpempem ne no.
18Na Sebulon ho nso, ɔkaa sɛ:
Sebulon, ma w’ani nnye w’adifire mu,
ne Isakar, wo ntomadan mu.
19Wɔbɛfrɛ aman akɔ bepɔ no so,
ɛhɔ na wɔbɛbɔ tenenee afɔdeɛ;
na wɔbɛfefe ɛpo mu mmorosoɔ
ne anwea mu ademudeɛ a ahunta.
20Na Gad ho nso, ɔkaa sɛ:
Nhyira ne deɛ ɔtrɛ Gad mu;
ɔbutu hɔ sɛ gyatabereɛ,
ɔtete basa ne mpampam;
21 # Num 32 ɔno na ɔyii deɛ ɛdi kan faeɛ,
na ɛhɔ na wɔakora mmarahyɛfoɔ no kyɛfa;
na ɔnam di ɔman no atitire mu,
ɔyɛ AWURADE teneneedeɛ
ne n’atemmudeɛ wɔ Israel.
22Na Dan ho nso, ɔkaa sɛ:
Dan yɛ gyataburuwa,
ɔhuri firi Basan.
23Na Naftali ho nso, ɔkaa sɛ:
Naftali a anisɔ amee no
na AWURADE nhyira ayɛ no ma,
fa ɛpo ne ahuhuro asase no di so.
24Na Aser ho nso, ɔkaa sɛ:
Ma wɔmfa mma nhyira Aser,
ɔnyɛ deɛ ɔsɔ ani ne nuanom mu,
na ɔmfa ne nan mmɔ ngo mu.
25Dadeɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nyɛ w’adaban,
sɛ wo nna teɛ no, saa na w’ahoɔden nyɛ.
26 # Yes 44.2 Obi nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ Yesurun Nyankopɔn!
Ɔnam soro di boa wo,
ɔde ne kɛseyɛ nam mununkum mu.
27Tete Nyankopɔn ne wo tenabea,
na aseɛ na daapem abasa no wɔ.
Na ɔbɛpamo ɔtamfoɔ w’anim,
na waka sɛ: Dwɛre wɔn.
28 # Num 23.9 Na Israel bɛtena hɔ dwoodwoo,
Yakob asubura no nkutoo,
ɔbɛtena aburoo ne nsa asase so;
ne soro nso bɛsosɔ obosuo.
29 # Deut 4.7-8; Dwom 33.12; 144.15 Nhyira ne wo, Israel, hwan na ɔte sɛ woɔ,
ɔman a wɔanya AWURADE mu nkwagyeɛ!
Ɔyɛ wo mmoa kyɛm,
na ɔyɛ wo kɛseyɛ nkrantɛ.
W’atamfo bɛwae ama wo,
na wo deɛ, wobɛtiatia wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
